title: Remove opaque semiring scalar retention
finding: TypedRelationBlock had explicit scalar contracts for boolean, natural, tropical, and evidence-dag values, but its fallback accepted bool/int/finite-float/EvidenceValue under any unknown semiring_name. That made an undeclared scalar semantics persistable and allowed custom integer semirings to bypass the bounded NaturalSemiring retention contract.
primary_claim: Non-empty relation blocks now fail closed when their semiring name has no explicit persisted scalar contract. Existing protocol-compatible backend substitutions remain possible when they implement one of the known semantic names; no semiring registry or parallel scalar schema is added.
gardener_decision: Delete the generic opaque-scalar fallback instead of inventing a custom-semiring registry, scalar wrapper, or second persistence schema. New non-zero scalar semantics must earn an explicit bounded canonical contract before TypedRelationBlock can retain them.
acceptance: a protocol-conforming semiring with an unknown name cannot persist a non-zero opaque scalar through from_coordinates
direct CSR construction cannot retain a scalar under an unknown semiring name
a protocol-conforming alternate backend using the known boolean semantic name still constructs the same canonical block
the four existing persisted scalar contracts remain unchanged
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert G1-TENSOR-01AM; Forest/Fourfold artifacts, identities, and authority are unchanged.
